arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of informational fields/sections you're interested in. This must be any subset of keys, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

result_fields.name: name
result_fields.description: LangDict object - name of the node

result_fields.name: visible_for_students
result_fields.description: boolean - if true marks and points of this node are visible to students

result_fields.name: type
result_fields.description: This fields will be equal to "task"

result_fields.name: points_precision
result_fields.description: Precision that should be used when displaying points from this node.

result_fields.name: my_permissions
result_fields.description: List of PermissionObjects representing permissions of of the access token issuer

result_fields.name: permissions
result_fields.description:
Dictionary mapping userIDs to list of PermissionObjects.
	Each such list contains PermissionObjects for a particular user.
	Only ids of users that have ReadPerm permission in the root will be present in this dictionary

result_fields.name: dependencies
result_fields.description: A dictionary mapping node IDs to handles(see algorithm note)

result_fields.name: variables
result_fields.description: string, variables used in the algorithm (see algorithm note)

result_fields.name: algorithm_description
result_fields.description: LangDict object - description of the algorithm (see algorithm note)
